name: agents
title: Agent controls
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Inspect agents and use the operations their runtimes expose.
description: Builds agent lists and live panels for prompts, steering, queues, requests and transcripts, using each runtime's advertised capabilities. It does not launch Pi itself. Turn it off to lose these controls and panels; backend-owned agents and their bridges keep running.

needs.why: Agents come from a runtime integration such as the Pi launcher
Agent panels open in a tab

works_with.without: Agent messages marked as markdown show as plain wrapped text
The agent facts line scrolls with the conversation instead of staying at the bottom
The conversation doesn't keep its view on the newest output

keys: Prefix p: prompt the focused agent
Prefix P: agent settings for the focused agent
panels: Agent details (the conversation from an item stream, with a facts line)
